name: ui-sounds
title: UI sounds
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Fourteen synthesized cues with a persisted mute, volume, theme, and emphasis. Playback waits for a user gesture.

meta.descriptionEs: Catorce cues sintetizados, con silencio, volumen, tema y énfasis guardados. No suena antes de un gesto.

examples.title: Sonidos de interfaz
examples.description: Catorce cues sintetizados, con silencio, volumen, tema y énfasis guardados. No suena antes de un gesto.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: 320px, texto largo, y lectura de derecha a izquierda.

api.name: playUiSound
api.description: Plays a cuelume cue after a user gesture. No-op while muted.

api.name: useUiSounds
api.description: muted, volume, theme, emphasis, and setters. Hydrates from local storage.

api.name: UiSoundsToggle / UiSoundsControls
api.description: Mute button, and controls for volume, theme, and emphasis.

api.name: theme / emphasis
api.description: default, mech, bubble, or press. subtle, normal, or strong.

docs: Wraps cuelume@0.2.4 (MIT, Daniel Belyi). The pin already includes the 14-cue palette. Preference storage is this wrapper. press-sound remains a compatible facade. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
